bps_sk_2020.name: Statistik Kriminal 2020: 'Jumlah Kejahatan Menurut Jenis Kejahatan dan Kepolisian Daerah' (crime by type and regional police), column Pembunuhan (murder/homicide)
bps_sk_2020.publisher: Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS-Statistics Indonesia); data from Biro Pengendalian Operasi, Mabes Polri (Police HQ Operations Control Bureau)
bps_sk_2020.years: 2017, 2018 (Lampiran tables 2.1.10-2.1.12; the 2019 table from this edition is superseded by the 2022 edition, identical total)
bps_sk_2020.notes: Extracted from the PDF text (pdftotext -layout). For every year the Polda values add up exactly to the printed Indonesia total (2017: 1,150; 2018: 1,024; 2019: 964; 2020: 898; 2021: 927; 2022: 854; 2023: 1,129; 2024: 1,106). '-' (nil) cells written as 0. Source notes: Polda Metro Jaya includes Mabes Polri (police HQ) cases and covers Jakarta plus neighbouring cities in West Java/Banten, so it is not matched to a province shape; Polda Papua covers crimes in all Papua provinces. Where two editions give the same year the latest edition is used.

bps_sk_2025_podes.name: Statistik Kriminal 2024/2025, Lampiran 14: villages/urban wards (desa/kelurahan) where a murder occurred in the past year, by province
bps_sk_2025_podes.publisher: Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS), Village Potential Survey (Podes)
bps_sk_2025_podes.notes: Count and percent of all desa/kelurahan in the province reporting at least one murder in the past year (Podes). Not a count of murders. Province counts add up to the printed Indonesia totals (916 and 749). New Papua provinces (2022) have values for 2024 only ('...' for 2021) and no geoBoundaries shape.

problems: bps.go.id pages are behind a Cloudflare check (HTTP 403 to curl); the PDF download links were read from the publication pages with WebFetch and the PDFs fetched from web-api.bps.go.id. The BPS web API needs a registered key, which was not available. Polda Jawa Barat and Banten exclude areas policed by Polda Metro Jaya, so their province shapes are larger than the Polda jurisdiction.
